Job Description Header:
ADMA Biologics is a biopharmaceutical company relentlessly committed to creating superior products for immunodeficient patients at risk for infection. It is our devotion to this underserved population that fuels us and our hands-on approach to production and development that sets us apart. If you are looking for a dynamic, innovative, growing company in the biopharmaceutical industry that is committed to excellence and integrity, then consider ADMA Biologics. We currently have an exciting opportunity available for a Senior Director, Quality Assurance in Boca Raton, FL!
Job Title:
Senior Director, Quality Assurance
Job Description:
Position Summary:
The Senior Director, Quality Assurance, is responsible for leading and executing the QA strategy for strong oversight of the end-to-end production for ADMA Biologics’ specialty plasma-derived products. This leader will ensure that materials, processes, facilities, and products meet applicable regulatory requirements and ADMA’s strict quality standards. The role requires sound GMP judgment, strong cross-functional leadership, and the ability to resolve complex quality issues while supporting reliable product supply.
Essential Functions and Responsibilities:
Lead and develop the QA teams responsible for manufacturing oversight, batch record review, product disposition, and quality systems execution.
Provide operational leadership and expertise in the development, implementation, and training of cGMP compliant quality systems, such as document control, change control, investigations, deviations, CAPA, and product quality complaints.
Provide independent quality oversight of plasma manufacturing operations, aseptic filling, packaging, and associated laboratory and support activities, as applicable.
Responsible for ensuring organizational goals are transmitted and communicated effectively throughout the QA department to include all members of the team.
As a member of senior management, works collaboratively and cross-functionally with other key leaders to ensure execution of department(s) and organizational goals. Assigns resources according to priority and project needs.
Establish performance measures and use quality trends to identify emerging risks, set priorities, and drive continuous improvement.
Direct the development of systems, practices, and processes to ensure effective ongoing review of manufacturing, facility, and process-related changes.
Provide leadership and direction during the investigation of deviations and quality related events.
Support inspection readiness and serve as a senior QA representative during FDA and other regulatory inspections, audits, and responses.
Maintain strong oversight of suppliers, contract service providers, and material quality issues in partnership with relevant functions.
Build a culture of accountability, clear documentation, timely escalation, and patient-focused decision-making.
Conduct regular audits and inspections, identifying areas for improvement and ensuring compliance with applicable quality standards.
Job Responsibilities or Job Requirements
Competencies
Ability to effectively manage staff. Ability to handle multiple priorities and tight deadlines. Understand concepts, requirements, and accounting issues for all business areas
FDA Adherence
Possesses excellent oral and written communication skills with close attention to detail and accuracy to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams and communicate findings and recommendations
Education and Experience Requirements:
Education Requirements:
Bachelor's degree in a scientific, engineering, or related field; advanced degree preferred.
Experience Requirements:
At least 15 years of progressive experience in pharmaceutical or biologics quality, including significant leadership experience in a GMP manufacturing environment.
Thorough knowledge of FDA regulations and applicable GMP requirements for biological products.
Demonstrated experience leading investigations, risk assessments, change control, system and process validation oversight, batch disposition, and inspection preparation.
Proven ability to make defensible quality decisions, communicate effectively with senior leaders and regulators, and lead teams through complex issues.
Strong written communication, organizational, and people leadership skills.
Compliance Requirements:
The minimum compliance expectation for this role entails strict adherence to FDA regulations and company policies governing sales and marketing activities. This includes completion of required compliance training, accurate documentation of sales interactions, and adherence to data privacy regulations. Additionally, the role requires proactive participation in compliance reviews, prompt reporting of any potential issues, and ongoing education to stay updated on relevant FDA regulations.
Job Description Footer:
In addition to competitive compensation, we offer a comprehensive benefits package including:
401K plan with employer match and immediate vesting
Medical, Vision, Life and Dental Insurance
Pet Insurance
Company paid STD and LTD
Company Paid Holidays
3 Weeks’ Paid Time Off (within the first year)

Lead the development, execution, and continuous improvement of IAG’s Issue Validation QC program, establishing a risk-based approach to assessing the rigor, consistency, and completeness of IAG issue validation activities.
Design, oversee and perform independent quality control reviews of issue validation work, including validation plans, testing procedures, supporting evidence, documented conclusions, closure recommendations, and operational execution.
Determine whether IAG validation procedures appropriately address the underlying risk(s) and root cause, corrective action commitments, sustainability of remediation, and the effectiveness of controls implemented to mitigate issue related risks.
Challenge insufficient IAG validation evidence, unsupported conclusions, weak and inadequate validation testing, and inappropriate issue closure conclusions; oversee timely resolution and escalation of QC observations.

Provide clear, actionable reporting to senior management and relevant governance committees on QC coverage, outcomes, trends, exceptions, remediation progress, and areas requiring management attention.
Support internal and external assessments and regulatory examinations involving issue validation practices, including evidence preparation, readiness activities, and presentation of QC processes and results as needed.
Monitor industry practices, IIA standards, and relevant regulatory guidance to identify enhancements to the Issue Validation QC framework.
Support and participate in cross-functional initiatives within Professional Practices and IAG to strengthen issue governance, validation discipline, and sustainable remediation.
Lead, coach, and develop issue validation QC colleagues, promoting sound judgment, effective challenge, consistent execution, and a culture of accountability.

Demonstrated people leadership experience and ability to coach, develop, and lead teams while maintaining independent, risk-based judgment.

VP of Operations
Divisions Maintenance Group
Cincinnati, OH
No longer accepting applications
Title: VP of Operations
Reports To: Chief Operating Officer
Department: GTM Leadership
Location: Cincinnati, OH
Position Status: Salary Exempt
About DMG:
Divisions Maintenance Group provides facility maintenance services to retail chains and distribution and fulfillment centers across the country.
We are leading the way with our technology, creating world-class products that are revolutionizing the industry and fulfilling our brand promise of “Uninterrupted Peace of Mind.”
DMG is a Certified Great Place to Work with a strong, inclusive culture and top-notch benefits.
Job Summary:
The Vice President of Operations manages and leads our business operations team, directly managing 4 leadership reports with oversight of 12 indirect reports, while owning operational performance for a ~$1 billion revenue company,driving standards for over 450 individuals who touch operations daily. In this high-visibility role, you will own the end-to-end execution, service quality, and continuous improvement of our work order fulfillment engine across all commercial service lines, upholding DMG’s core brand promise of Speed, Quality, and Cost. You will oversee the operational architecture connecting customer requests with a nationwide network of service providers across all major trades (landscaping, snow removal, plumbing, electrical, and facility maintenance). Success in this role is defined by three core outcomes: reducing the work order lifecycle, maximizing service reliability through assignment and arrival metrics, and driving defect reduction alongside swift resolution protocols.
What You'll Do:
Work Order Lifecycle Optimization: Analyze and streamline every phase of the work order lifecycle to eliminate operational friction, automate intake and dispatch, and accelerate turnaround times.
Service Reliability & Execution: Drive provider assignment and arrival metrics across all trades,ensuring high acceptance rates and strict on-time schedule compliance.
Quality Excellence & Defect Reduction: Implement quality assurance controls and real-time monitoring solutions to reduce customer-identified defects.
Rapid Defect Resolution: Establish fast-reaction protocols and root-cause frameworks to resolve customer-reported issues swiftly and prevent repeat failures.
Operational Accountability: Establish and communicate clear performance expectations, operating standards, and accountability measures for operational leaders and teams; continuously monitor performance, provide targeted coaching, and hold leaders strictly accountable for the results of their assigned areas.
Operational Leadership: Lead, mentor, and scale a high-performing operations team dedicated to accountability, urgency, and operational excellence.
Process Standardization & Best Practices: Proactively identify and scale best practices, standardized operating processes, and successful service models across teams, markets, and trades to drive organizational consistency and continuous improvement.
Financial Oversight & Margin Management: Exercise strict financial oversight on proposal creations, timely customer billing, and large-scale project execution to eliminate operational margin erosion, control revenue leakage, and consistently achieve agreed-upon profitability targets.
Provider Network Accountability: Partner with provider management teams to enforce operational metrics and technology-enabled tracking for third-party contractors.
Cross-Functional Alignment & Resource Orchestration: Partner closely with cross-functional support teams - including HR, Finance, Product/Engineering, and GTM leaders to secure the necessary resources, alignment, and strategic support to execute operational initiatives and achieve core business objectives.
Other duties as assigned by management.
What You Need:
Bachelor’s degree in Business, Operations, Facilities Management, or Engineering (MBA preferred).
12+ years of progressive operational leadership experience within facility management, marketplace operations, third-party logistics (3PL), or tech-enabled service delivery.
Demonstrated track record of driving core operational metrics: lifecycle reduction, schedule adherence/arrival rates, and defect reduction.
Proven track record in process improvement methodologies (Lean, Six Sigma, Root-Cause Analysis) with expertise in auditing complex, cross-functional workflows to design and deploy scalable, data-driven solutions.
An urgent, data-driven leader who takes full ownership of outcomes within matrix organizations; combines rigorous metric tracking and a test-and-learn mindset.
